scientific_question: Can synchronized post-entry failure across the frozen weekly cohort improve annualized return where individual candlestick exits failed?
motivation_frozen_from_visual_review: Individual entry candles overlap heavily between winners and losers.
Individual d3/d5/d10/d15 exits reduce severe losses but also cut recoveries and failed the return gate.
Losing charts frequently cluster by signal date, suggesting cohort-level failure may be more informative than an individual stop.

single_candidate_translation.name: SYNCHRONIZED_COHORT_FAILURE_EXIT

rule_1.condition: at least 70% of the actually executed cohort closes below its own signal-day low
rule_1.action: exit every still-live lot in that cohort at its next legal sellable open

rule_2.condition: median close-from-entry return of the actually executed cohort is at most -3%
rule_2.action: exit every still-live lot in that cohort at its next legal sellable open

single_candidate_translation.priority: earliest triggered rule wins; rule 2 is evaluated only for cohorts not already triggered
single_candidate_translation.missingness: fail closed: a checkpoint cannot trigger unless every originally executed non-corporate-action-exited member has a valid causal checkpoint observation

portfolio_replay_authorization: Only if both generation and fixed-validation gates pass; then one unchanged full-period replay is allowed.
